Definition: to precipitate or hurl (rush) headlong; (intransitively) to be rash
BiblicalUsage: Yâraṭ means to rush headlong, to be rash and precipitate. Job said God had delivered him to the ungodly and turned him over into the hands of the wicked, and the angel told Balaam his way was perverse before the LORD.
TheologicalSignificance: I believe a rash way is a perverse way, and God stands in the road to stop it.
